Running command: cd /tmp; for n in 121 122 123 124 125 126 127 128 129; do
python3 -c "
key = 'a'*$n
content = 'defaults {\n    %s = \"val\"\n}\nmything {\n    .inherit \"defaults\"\n}\n' % key
open('/tmp/t_$n.ucl','w').write(content)
"
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/harness /tmp/t_$n.ucl >/tmp/out_$n.txt 2>&1
echo "n=$n exit=$? $(grep -c 'heap-buffer-overflow' /tmp/out_$n.txt)"
done
